messages:
maria: Heads up — partner ingestion logs from yesterday include a Vault export that contains a KMS-wrapped blob. Looks like a partner debug snapshot accidentally uploaded. :grimacing:
kevin: can you paste the blob id? is it unwrapped anywhere public? :eyes:
maria: blob id: projects/redwood-prod/locations/us/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/wrap-2024/cryptoKeyVersions/3 — the exported file is encrypted (wrapped) but the partner log has the ciphertext and the associated key resource path.
jamie: ok that key path is in our GCP KMS ring used by the private Vault cluster. No raw plaintext seen yet, still wrapped, but exposure of key resource + ciphertext increases blast radius. We need a plan: rewrap backup material to a new key, restrict IAM binding on the key, and enable audit forwarding for KMS API calls to the security log sink.
maria: proposal: 1) create a new key (wrap-2024-b) 2) rewrap any stored ciphertexts in our backups 3) rotate Vault to use new key 4) revoke IAM grant for partner project 5) update audit-forwarder to include KMS Admin events. anyone object?
kevin: +1. add a short freeze window for vault write/read during rewrap to avoid races. ops-oncall, can you own the maintenance window?
ops-oncall: I can take a 30m window tonight 23:30-00:00 UTC. I'll coordinate a canary first. put me on the thread for exact commands.
jamie: commands I'll run in the plan (preview):
```bash
# create new key (global ring)
gcloud kms keys create wrap-2024-b --keyring=ingest --location=us --purpose=encryption
# grant only Vault SA the cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter role
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding wrap-2024-b --member=serviceAccount:vault-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
# remove partner binding (explicit revoke)
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding wrap-2024 --member=serviceAccount:partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```
kevin: for rewrap, we'll use the rewrap helper to translate ciphertexts server-side to new key so we never decrypt in process. example: Vault has rewrap endpoint — call with: rewrap(ciphertext, dest_key=wrap-2024-b). ops-oncall: confirm Vault version supports rewrap API.
ops-oncall: Vault 1.13+ supports rewrap in our deployment, yes. I'll run a canary rewrap on a small backup and verify checksums.
maria: also we need to patch audit pipeline: ensure KMS Admin and CryptoKey access logs are forwarded to our Splunk/alarm rule and that Vault audit messages include key_id mapping. Right now logs show KMS calls but not correlated with vault mount ids.
jamie: plan to add a small mapping table in the audit-bridge service: key_resource -> vault_mount. That will let us annotate KMS events with vault context before forwarding. I'll open a PR to the audit-bridge with a one-off migration.
kevin: RBAC change: reduce bindings on wrap-2024 to only roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyViewer for auditing (read-only) for security principals; remove encrypter role except Vault SA and infra-admins. We'll need IAM review for any other services.
maria: who will rotate the partner's leaked blob metadata in the partner contract? legal ops already pinged partner-sso, but we should coordinate the deprovision.
kevin: security-bot run quick-scan on S3/GCS buckets for matching ciphertext pattern and list objects referencing the key path. security-bot: queued scan job.
security-bot: scan started, ETA ~8m — results will be in #eng-security-alerts when done.
ops-oncall: I'm good to execute tonight. maria, jamie, kevin — leave me a runbook snippet for rollback and postmortem notes. I'll record the window.
maria: runbook snippet: 
1) create wrap-2024-b and verify IAM
2) snapshot Vault config + secrets wrapper status
3) pause writes to mount=kv-secrets for 30m
4) canary rewrap object(s) -> verify checksums and app decryption against canary env
5) full rewrap via Vault rewrap API queued with concurrency 8
6) update vault config to point to wrap-2024-b and restart vault-proxy
7) remove partner IAM from wrap-2024 and add read-only principals for auditing
8) audit-bridge deploy with mapping table and verify KMS events annotate correctly
rollback: restore snapshot, revert vault config, re-add old IAM binding.
jamie: I'll draft a tiny eval script to verify a few secrets: send test decrypt requests to Vault using the new key and confirm identical plaintext outputs to pre-wrap checksums.
kevin: timeline ok. Once security-bot finishes scan, post objects and we'll enumerate exact keys to rewrap. after cleanup, we'll file a short incident note and schedule a 90-day followup for IAM pruning. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks all — cc @ops-oncall on the calendar invite. I'll update partner legal thread with our mitigation plan.
security-bot: scan finished — 2 matches found in partner-debug-logs/2026-03-21/*, not publicly readable but retained by partner. See #eng-security-alerts for object list.
ops-oncall: received the object list, starting canary at 23:30 UTC. I'll update here with progress and timings.
maria: appreciated. Will keep this channel as the canonical coordination thread. :lock:
